_comment: Measured content coverage per language: rows in D1 mt_cache whose TARGET is that language, as a percentage of the best-covered language. Refresh with `pnpm gen:locale-content` (queries D1 through the same Cloudflare credentials the warm job uses) and re-run `pnpm gen:locale-readiness`. Source languages carry no mt_cache rows because nothing is translated INTO them: Indonesian is what the site is written in, and Arabic is the Qur'an and hadith themselves.
